last_analysis: Scores are hidden, so all I know is that every trial ran. The 1-epoch recipe (r2c1) gave 3x the default's environment steps and stayed inside the time limit, and so did networks up to 1.89x the starting compute. On this task the main thing should be how fast fresh designs are seen and how precisely each footprint's landing height is read. Neither seed noise nor scores can be judged from what I have. This last round should combine plausible pieces, not open new axes. (1) The richest network so far (dilated trunk with context heads) with a longer-horizon recipe, so the final +1 bonus gets more credit. (2) The deep-column network with the same longer horizon. (3) A new head idea: a learned convolution the size of each footprint over projected features. It sees each cell under the brick separately, not just the max, min and mean.
